in_sanskrit.name: Megala
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Meghali is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Megala', which means 'large, great'. In Hindu mythology, Meghala is also the name of the goddess of clouds and rain.

in_hindi.name: मेघला
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Meghali in Hindi is derived from the words 'Megh' meaning 'cloud' and 'Al' meaning 'one who has'. This name suggests a person who brings rain and clouds, just like the goddess Meghala in Hindu mythology.

in_tamil.name: மேகலி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Meghali in Tamil is derived from the words 'Mekam' meaning 'cloud' and 'Li' meaning 'one who has'. This name also conveys the idea of a person who has the power to bring rain and clouds.

in_telugu.name: మేఘలీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Meghali in Telugu is derived from the words 'Megulu' meaning 'cloud' and 'Lee' meaning 'one who has'. This name signifies a person who has the power to bring rain and clouds, just like the goddess Meghala in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Meghali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meghali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Megha (cloud) + Ali (borne). Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Megha' which means 'cloud'. In Hindu mythology, Megha is the Goddess of clouds and rain. This name is bestowed upon a girl born under the clouds or during rain.
